question: Where can I find restaurant that falls within 150 kilometers in the direction of travel toward University of New Haven New London Campus, New London, CT?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.896423 41.316453)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.092202 41.327524)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.896423 41.316453)',4326)::geography, 150000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.896423 41.316453)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
